title: Appraisal Order Report Age, Transfer and Review Limits
content:
Collateral limits for Appraisal Order reports, by report type. Ages are counted in calendar days from the inspection date to the note date.

| Report type | Validity (days) | Maximum age with a Form 1004D update (days) | Transfer from another lender allowed | Second full appraisal above base loan amount (USD) | Collateral Underwriter desk review threshold | Desk review chargeable to borrower |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 120 | 0 | No | 0.00 | 2.5 | No |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 120 | 365 | Yes | 0.00 | 2.5 | No |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 120 | 365 | Yes | 0.00 | 2.5 | No |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 120 | 365 | Yes | 0.00 | 2.5 | No |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 180 | 240 | Yes | 0.00 | 2.5 | No |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 120 | 365 | Yes | 0.00 | 2.5 | No |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 120 | 365 | Yes | 1500000.00 | 2.5 | No |

**Definitions.**
1. *Validity* — the maximum age of the report, in calendar days from the inspection date to the note date, without an update: 120 days, and 180 days for the Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA).
2. *Maximum age with an update* — the maximum age, in calendar days from the inspection date to the note date, reachable with a Form 1004D update. A figure of 0 means updates are not accepted: the Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) cannot be updated.
3. *Transfer* — whether a report ordered by another lender can be transferred into the file; it cannot for the Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop).
4. *Second full appraisal threshold* — the base loan amount above which a second full appraisal is required and charged. A figure of 0.00 means a second appraisal on this ground is never required; only the Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) has one, at 1,500,000 dollars.
5. *Desk review threshold* — the Collateral Underwriter score, to one decimal place, above which Larkspur orders a desk review at its own expense: 2.5 for every report type. A desk review Larkspur orders is not chargeable to the borrower for any report type.

*Hypothetical reading:* a Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) order on a file with a base loan amount of 1,500,000.00 dollars is at the threshold, not above it; at 1,500,000.01 dollars it is above it.
